Job Description: **Who we are:**


Superior Glove is a family\-owned company with over 100 years in designing and manufacturing innovative hand protection for every major hazard. We innovate to fit the protection workers need into comfortable PPE they’ll want to wear. Headquartered in Acton, Canada, Superior Glove has grown from humble beginnings to a global contender, with several locations across Ontario, Newfoundland, Alberta, Quebec, Honduras, New York, Louisiana and Mexico.

**The ideal candidate:**


Are you a highly creative designer with a passion for transforming ideas into impactful visual experiences? Do you enjoy managing projects from concept to completion while producing exceptional work across digital and print platforms?  

We're looking for an experienced **Senior Graphic Designer** who combines outstanding design expertise with strong project management skills and a strategic mindset. You'll thrive in a fast\-paced marketing environment, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to develop compelling visual communications that strengthen our brand and support business objectives. You'll enjoy solving creative challenges, balancing multiple priorities, and producing polished, on\-brand creative that makes an impact.  

Superior Glove Works Ltd. is currently hiring for a **Senior Graphic Designer** to work out of our Global Headquarters in Acton, Ontario. This position offers a hybrid work environment, with regular onsite collaboration required. **More about the role:**


Reporting to the Design Strategist, Team Lead, the Senior Graphic Designer is responsible for developing and executing high\-quality visual communications that support Superior Glove's marketing and brand strategies. This role manages creative projects from concept through final production while collaborating with marketing, product management, sales, and other stakeholders to deliver engaging creative across multiple channels. The successful candidate will also contribute to the ongoing evolution of our visual identity, brand standards, and creative processes while supporting and mentoring other members of the design team.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Design and produce high\-quality creative assets across print, digital, web, email, social media, packaging, advertising, events, presentations, and other marketing channels.
* Execute creative work across multiple disciplines including graphic design, photography, illustration, motion graphics, and video as required.
* Translate marketing strategies, creative briefs, and business objectives into compelling visual communications.
* Manage assigned creative projects from concept through final production, ensuring projects are delivered on time and meet quality expectations.
* Coordinate project timelines, communicate progress, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Develop creative concepts and visual solutions for campaigns, product launches, and brand initiatives.
* Present creative concepts and incorporate stakeholder feedback into final deliverables.
* Support the ongoing development and maintenance of Superior Glove's brand standards, design systems, templates, and creative assets.
* Provide guidance and day\-to\-day design support to junior and intermediate designers.
* Recommend improvements to creative workflows, processes, and team efficiencies while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of professional graphic design experience across print and digital marketing channels.
* Minimum 3 years of progressive project management experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and related applications.
* Strong knowledge of branding, typography, print production, digital design, and visual communication principles.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and project management platforms such as Asana.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects while working effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Excellent communication, presentation, organizational, and project management skills.
* Positive, collaborative, adaptable, and solutions\-focused approach.
* Experience in B2B marketing is preferred, while industrial or manufacturing experience is considered an asset.
**A professional portfolio of relevant work is required as part of your application.** **Why work for us?**


Superior Glove is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage and welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work culture to ensure every voice is heard and valued.

  

When you work at Superior Glove, you are part of the family!

  

Some of the benefits/perks include:

* Yearly contenders and recipients of multiple prestigious awards including Canada’s Best Managed for over 10 years, Canada’s Safest Manufacturer, Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces, Canada’s Excellence Business Award and more!
* Enjoy our Recognition Program to gain access to fantastic rewards!
* Access to our on\-site fitness lessons, equipment, “Grab and Go” bikes and more
* Take part in community and company events, staff lunch adventures and annual barbeques!
  

We are a family owned and operated company meeting international standards by **“Improving Occupational Hand Protection through Innovation”**  

Superior Glove strives to create a respectful, accessible, and inclusive work environment. Upon individual request, the company will endeavor to remove any barrier to the hiring process to accommodate candidates with disabilities.

Job Description: About Us

We are collaborative, multidisciplinary group practice dedicated to supporting individuals across the lifespan with ADHD, Learning Disabilities, Autism, and related challenges. We offer flexible, evidence\-based services through a virtual care model. Our team includes physicians, psychologists, psychotherapists, and educational professionals working together to deliver science\-driven, client\-centered care.

About the Role

We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator to support clinical research studies and trial activities in a fast\-paced research environment. This is a casual position with the opportunity to grow in hours and responsibilities over time based on performance and study needs.

Key Responsibility

* Coordinate and support clinical research studies in accordance with study protocols and regulatory requirements
* Conduct study visits and perform research\-related procedures as required
* Collect and document clinical data, including vital signs, ECGs, and phlebotomy procedures as required by study protocols
* Maintain accurate source documentation, study records, and data entry
* Ensure compliance with GCP, ethics, and regulatory guidelines
* Communicate with investigators, sponsors, research staff, and study participants
* Assist with regulatory documentation and study administration

Qualifications

* Minimum 2 years of clinical research coordination experience
* Experience in industry\-sponsored clinical trials, interventional studies, or related clinical research environments preferred
* Bachelor's degree in science, Nursing, or a related healthcare field required
* Strong understanding of clinical research regulations and guidelines, including ICH\-GCP and applicable regulatory processes
* Ability to independently perform study\-related procedures, including vital signs, ECGs, and phlebotomy as required
* Strong organizational, documentation, and communication skills
* Candidates with international clinical research experience may be considered where experience is relevant and verifiable
* International Medical Graduate (IMG) considered an asset
* Nursing background with clinical research experience preferred
* Experience supporting regulatory compliance and research documentation
* Flexible availability to support study scheduling and operational needs

What we offer

* Competitive hourly compensation of $32–$37/hr, commensurate with experience
* Casual role with potential to increase hours and scope based on performance and study needs
* Opportunity to gain experience in industry\-sponsored clinical research and interventional trials
* Exposure to diverse clinical studies and hands\-on research procedures
* Collaborative, research\-focused environment with opportunities for professional growth
* Paid vacation time.
* Employer\-matched contributions to a Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP).

If you are passionate about contributing to clinical research and advancing patient care in a collaborative environment, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Pay: $32\.00\-$37\.00 per hour

Experience:

* industry clinical research coordination: 2 years (required)

Work Location: In person

Across our three hospitals and eight satellite sites, **Scarborough Health Network (SHN)** is shaping the future of care. Our many programs and services are designed around the needs of one of Canada’s most vibrant and diverse communities. We are home to North America’s largest nephrology program, as well as the designated cardiac care and spine centre for Scarborough and surrounding communities to the east. We are proud to be a community\-affiliated teaching site for the University of Toronto and partner with a number of other universities and colleges, helping to train the next generation of health care professionals. SHN is the recipient of the 2021 Excellence in Diversity and Inclusion Award, from the Canadian College of Health Leaders, for our leading edge work on Communities of Inclusion, Inclusion Calendar, Health Equity Certificate Program and much more. We are also proud to be named **Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures for 2023 and 2024!** Learn more at shn.ca

**Job Description:**

 **Position Overview:**


The Scarborough Health Network Research Institute (SHNRI) is dedicated to supporting SHN researchers and their teams in achieving their research goals. In this job, you will perform and support Critical Care studies and research activities at SHN under the direction of the SHNRI and principal investigators for research studies. The research assistant provides the necessary oversight and guidance to ensure regulatory compliance, grant administration, and quality control in study conduct.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Supports the preparation and organization of regulatory documents, delegation logs, and study binders
* Schedules and prepares for Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), and overall study logistics
* Ensure SHNRI SharePoint is up to date with all study documents to foster collaboration
* Performs data entry into Case Report Forms (CRFs) from health records and source documents as per protocol
* Resolves data queries with minimal supervision
* Prepares, receives, sorts and processes clinical research samples following established procedures and in compliance with applicable regulations
* Provide support and assistance to the study team in preparing environment for conducting research activities as per protocol
* Timely communications with the Research Ethics Board (REB) e.g. prepare REB applications, amendments, renewals, and other correspondence and ensure proper filing
* Tracks approval timelines and ensures proper documentation is maintained
* Aid PI’s in setting up finances for their studies
* Interact with study participants e.g., scheduling appointments, informed consenting for low\-risk trials, and other general Research Institute administrative functions
* Apply for grants as instructed by the RI or the PI
* Other duties as required

**Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or college diploma in health\-related studies
* Excellent interpersonal skills, the successful candidate will work in an office environment and with health professionals such as nurses, physicians, research staff and patients
* Patient screening and informed consent process experience
* Data input; experience using different Sponsor/ Clinical Research Organization (CRO) platforms e.g. REDCap, Medidata
* Familiarity with medical terminology
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Programs such as MS Teams, SharePoint and Word
* Great in person and telephone communication skills, including the ability to accurately summarize and communicate information
* Good time management, organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple competing demands
* Ability to work independently as well as in a multi\-disciplinary team

**Assets:**

**Certifications in the following:**

* Tri\-Council Policy Statement (TCPS 2\)
* Health Canada Division 5
* Canada GCP
* Transportation of Dangerous Goods (TDG/IATA)
* Phlebotomy
* CCRP

**Knowledge of the following:**

* Declaration of Helsinki
* Clinical Trial Recruitment
* REB submission process
* Grant writing, review and administration
* Preparation and assistance experience during the conduct of auditing and inspection visits

*Accommodation and Diversity Statement:*  

*Scarborough Health Network (SHN) embraces and celebrates our community’s unique multicultural heritage and diversity. SHN is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a culture of inclusiveness and diversity reflecting our diverse patients, staff and community alike.*

 *We are committed to fostering an environment of equity and inclusivity where every person can work and receive care safely, openly and honestly. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nation of origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital or family status, belief system, or other factors related to one’s personal identity and/or values.*

 *We are committed to providing barrier\-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Should you require accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.*

Job Description: **Job Type**: Full\-time, Permanent

**Location**: Richmond Hill (On\-site)

**Experience Level**: Relevant 2\-4 years hands\-on experience

**About the Role**

At LightArt Labs, we are developing a medical device that relies on a production\-grade computer vision image classification pipeline. We have already completed model exploration and selected a strong baseline architecture. The remaining work is to close the gap to production readiness by improving model performance, robustness, and efficiency, while tightening evaluation discipline and delivery quality.

The Research Associate will participate in research activities and perform a number of tasks related to the ongoing research in the diagnostic field. You will collaborate closely with our medical/biological team and engineering, and you must be able to deliver results under tight deadlines.

**Responsibilities**

* To plan and execute experiments assigned by scientists
* To perform sample processing and relevant downstream assays
* Follow established protocols to perform manual or automated sample processing of different blood sample types
* Follow established protocols to handle CL2 microorganisms
* To support the Engineering team for validation and troubleshooting during product integration
* Maintain operation records and other relevant activities
* Timely submission of requested results and analysis

* Tracks approval timelines and ensures proper documentation is maintained
* Aid PI’s in setting up finances for their studies

* Apply for grants as instructed by the RI or the PI
* Other duties as required

**Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or college diploma in health\-related studies
* Excellent interpersonal skills, the successful candidate will work in an office environment and with health professionals such as nurses, physicians, research staff and patients

* Data input; experience using different Sponsor/ Clinical Research Organization (CRO) platforms e.g. REDCap, Medidata
* Familiarity with medical terminology
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Programs such as MS Teams, SharePoint and Word
* Great in person and telephone communication skills, including the ability to accurately summarize and communicate information
* Good time management, organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple competing demands
* Ability to work independently as well as in a multi\-disciplinary team

**Assets:**

**Certifications in the following:**

* Tri\-Council Policy Statement (TCPS 2\)
* Health Canada Division 5
* Canada GCP
* Transportation of Dangerous Goods (TDG/IATA)
* Phlebotomy
* CCRP

* REB submission process
* Grant writing, review and administration
